definition.text: Protected by Jehovah, the name of a town in the tribe of Benjamin between Nob and Hazor (Neh. 11:32). It is probably the modern Beit Hanina, a small village 3 miles north of Jerusalem.

lemmas.gloss: Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Pale
Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites
